title: Longest Almost-Palindromic Substring
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring that becomes a palindrome after removing exactly one character.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring that becomes a palindrome after removing exactly one character.
constraints: s is a nonempty lowercase string of length up to 2,000.
Choose a contiguous substring and remove exactly one of its characters.
Return the original substring length when the remaining characters form a palindrome.
known_wrong_solutions:
def longest_almost_palindrome(s):
    n=len(s);answer=0
    def expand(left,right):
        while left>=0 and right<n and s[left]==s[right]:left-=1;right+=1
        best=right-left-1
        a,b=left,right
        while a>=0 and b<n and s[a]==s[b]:a-=1;b+=1
        best=max(best,b-a-1)
        a,b=left,right+1
        while a>=0 and b<n and s[a]==s[b]:a-=1;b+=1
        return min(n,max(best,b-a-1))
    for center in range(n):answer=max(answer,expand(center,center),expand(center,center+1))
    return answer
def longest_almost_palindrome(s):
    n=len(s);answer=0
    def expand(left,right):
        while left>=0 and right<n and s[left]==s[right]:left-=1;right+=1
        best=right-left-1
        a,b=left-1,right
        while a>=0 and b<n and s[a]==s[b]:a-=1;b+=1
        best=max(best,b-a-1)
        a,b=left,right+1
        while a>=0 and b<n and s[a]==s[b]:a-=1;b+=1
        return best
    for center in range(n):answer=max(answer,expand(center,center),expand(center,center+1))
    return answer
hints: After expanding a palindrome center, the first mismatch is the only place a deletion can help.
Try skipping either side of that mismatch and continue matching outward.
Evaluate both odd and even centers and retain the largest original span, capped by the string length.
Every almost-palindrome has a center; outside its one deleted character, expansion is forced, so one of the two skips reconstructs it.

tests.explanation: Removing b or c leaves a palindrome, so the full length four qualifies.
Any length-two substring can lose one character and become a palindrome; length three cannot.
